auth_config.notes: Three accounts created: user, coach, admin. All have onboarding_completed=true. Auto-confirm enabled.

tests.title: Login happy path with valid credentials
tests.description: Verify that a user can log in with valid email/password and is redirected to the dashboard.
tests.expected_result: User is redirected to /dashboard and the page renders with data-testid='page-dashboard'
tests.pass_criteria: URL is /dashboard AND element [data-testid='page-dashboard'] is visible

tests.title: Login with invalid credentials shows error
tests.description: Verify that wrong password shows an error toast.
tests.expected_result: An error toast appears with text 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' and user remains on /login
tests.pass_criteria: URL is still /login AND a toast/alert with text containing 'incorrect' is visible

tests.title: Unauthenticated user redirected to login
tests.description: Verify that accessing a protected route while logged out redirects to /login.
tests.expected_result: User is redirected to /login
tests.pass_criteria: URL is /login AND element [data-testid='page-login'] is visible

tests.title: Session persists after page refresh
tests.description: Verify that refreshing the page keeps the user logged in.
steps: Step 3: Wait for page to load
tests.expected_result: User remains on /dashboard after refresh
tests.pass_criteria: URL is /dashboard AND element [data-testid='page-dashboard'] is visible

tests.title: Logout redirects to login and blocks protected routes
tests.description: Verify logout flow.
tests.expected_result: After logout, user is on /login and cannot access /dashboard
tests.pass_criteria: URL is /login after both the logout and the /dashboard attempt

tests.title: 404 page for unknown route
tests.description: Verify navigating to a nonexistent route shows 404 page.
steps: Step 2: Wait for page to render
tests.expected_result: 404 page is displayed
tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='page-not-found'] is visible AND text '404' is visible on the page

tests.title: Sidebar navigation to Leads page
tests.description: Verify clicking 'Leads' in sidebar navigates to /leads.
steps: Step 2: Wait for page to load
tests.expected_result: URL changes to /leads and leads page renders

tests.title: Sidebar navigation to Follow-ups page

tests.title: Sidebar navigation to Settings page

steps: Step 2: Wait for page to load
tests.expected_result: URL changes to /settings and settings page renders
tests.pass_criteria: URL is /settings AND element [data-testid='page-settings'] is visible

tests.title: Dashboard renders with KPI cards
tests.description: Verify the dashboard page loads and displays KPI cards.
steps: Step 2: Wait for page to load
tests.expected_result: Dashboard renders with KPI grid visible
tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='page-dashboard'] is visible AND element [data-testid='dashboard-kpi-grid'] is visible

tests.description: Verify the leads page loads and shows either the leads table or an empty state.
steps: Step 2: Wait for data to load (loading text disappears)
tests.expected_result: Page renders with either a leads table or empty state message
tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='page-leads'] is visible AND (element [data-testid='leads-table'] is visible OR element [data-testid='leads-empty-state'] is visible)

tests.title: Follow-ups page renders with empty state

steps: Step 2: Wait for page to load

tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='page-follow-ups'] is visible AND element [data-testid='followups-empty-state'] is visible

tests.title: Create a new lead from CRM
tests.description: Verify a user can create a new lead from the Leads page.
steps: Step 6: Wait for modal to close and table to update
tests.expected_result: Lead is created and appears in the leads table
tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='leads-table'] is visible AND text 'TestPrenom' is visible in the table

tests.title: Create lead from Dashboard
tests.description: Verify a user can create a new lead from the Dashboard's 'Nouveau lead' button.
tests.expected_result: Lead is created and a success toast appears
tests.pass_criteria: A toast with text 'Lead créé' appears

tests.title: View lead detail in drawer
tests.description: Verify clicking a lead row opens the lead detail drawer.
steps: Step 2: Click on the first lead row in the table
Step 3: Wait for drawer to open
tests.expected_result: Lead detail drawer opens with lead info
tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='lead-detail-drawer'] is visible

tests.title: Delete a single lead from drawer
tests.description: Verify a user can delete a lead from the lead detail drawer.
steps: Step 2: Click on a lead row to open the drawer
Step 4: In the confirmation dialog, click [data-testid='delete-confirm-action']
tests.expected_result: Lead is deleted, drawer closes, and lead disappears from the table
tests.pass_criteria: Toast with text 'Lead supprimé' appears AND the deleted lead is no longer visible in the table

tests.title: Bulk delete multiple leads
tests.description: Verify selecting multiple leads and bulk deleting them works.
steps: Step 2: Check the checkbox on the first two lead rows
Step 5: In the confirmation dialog, click [data-testid='delete-confirm-action']
tests.expected_result: Selected leads are deleted and the bulk actions bar disappears
tests.pass_criteria: Toast with text 'leads supprimés' appears AND [data-testid='leads-bulk-actions'] is no longer visible

tests.title: Search leads by name
tests.description: Verify the search input filters leads by first or last name.
preconditions: At least one lead exists with name 'TestPrenom'
steps: Step 3: Wait for table to update
tests.expected_result: Only leads matching the search term are shown
tests.pass_criteria: All visible rows in [data-testid='leads-table'] contain 'TestPrenom'

tests.title: Search with no results shows empty state
tests.description: Verify searching for a nonexistent name shows empty state.
steps: Step 3: Wait for table to update
tests.expected_result: Empty state message is shown
tests.pass_criteria: Element [data-testid='leads-empty-state'] is visible OR text 'Aucun lead trouvé' is visible

tests.title: Change lead status via dropdown
tests.description: Verify a user can change a lead's status using the status dropdown in the table.
preconditions: At least one lead with status 'conversation_engagee'
steps: Step 2: Find a lead with status 'Engagées'
Step 3: Click its status dropdown and select 'En cours'
Step 4: Wait for toast 'Statut mis à jour'
tests.expected_result: Lead status changes to 'En cours' and toast appears
tests.pass_criteria: Toast with text 'Statut mis à jour' appears AND the lead row shows the new status

tests.title: Update profile name
tests.description: Verify the user can update their full name in settings.
steps: Step 2: Clear the 'Nom complet' input and type 'Lisa Test Updated'
Step 4: Wait for toast 'Profil mis à jour'
tests.expected_result: Profile is saved and success toast appears
tests.pass_criteria: Toast with text 'Profil mis à jour' appears
